description: If Saigon port closed for 6 weeks due to typhoon or political escalation
trigger_event: Typhoon category 4+ or geopolitical escalation blocking shipping
mitigation_options: Activate alternate ports (air freight for 50% volume); emergency dual sourcing to India/Mexico; accelerate inbound shipments before event

description: Vietnam supplier accounting for 25% of SKU supply declares bankruptcy
mitigation_options: Dual source activation with India supplier (pre-qualified); emergency purchase orders at premium rates; renegotiate remaining inventory

description: US-China tensions escalate to naval blockade of Taiwan strait
mitigation_options: Reroute via Cape of Good Hope (9-day delay); activate air freight for critical SKUs; source alternatives from non-affected regions

description: Bangladesh factory damage from monsoon flooding disrupts production 8 weeks
trigger_event: Extreme weather event and flooding in production region
mitigation_options: Shift to secondary facilities (Mexico/India); accelerate current orders; arrange sea freight from alternate suppliers; negotiate extension of orders

description: Energy cost inflation of 40%+ from supply shortages or geopolitical event
trigger_event: Supply shock or geopolitical disruption affecting energy markets
mitigation_options: Accelerate energy hedging; shift manufacturing to lower-cost regions; renegotiate energy contracts; optimize production scheduling
